Class SshServer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.SshServer
@Component public class SshServer extends Object
The SshServer class is the Casserole SSH listener. Apache MINA SSHD is the library that accepts the password, binds the port, and loads the host key from the casserole settings. Each connection asks ChatShellFactory for a shell. The listen loop runs on the SSH input-output lane. The bean does not start itself. InitRunner calls start(). Lamina receives the listen task from that call. A stop lets the failed accept land before the group executor closes.

      public SshServer(CasseroleProperties properties, ChatShellFactory shellFactory, UserAccounts userAccounts, Lamina lamina)
      The constructor stores the settings, the shell factory, the accounts, and the thread model.
      Parameters:
      properties - The properties are the casserole SSH settings.
      shellFactory - The shell factory builds one chat shell per connection.
      userAccounts - The accounts are the password rows.
      lamina - The lamina is the server thread model.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      The method submits the MINA listen loop onto the SSH input-output lane. A listen task that is already running returns without a second submit.

    • shutdown

      @PreDestroy public void shutdown()
      The method stops MINA and then releases the listen task. The group waits inside sshd.stop(). The listen task stays until that wait returns. A stop failure is logged. The method logs when the stop begins and when it ends.
